name: Haloxazolam
summary: Haloxazolam (marketed in Japan under the brand name Somelin), is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. It has similar hypnotic properties as the benzodiazepine drugs triazolam, temazepam, and flunitrazepam and as such is indicated for the treatment of insomnia.

pharmacology.text: It has similar hypnotic properties as the benzodiazepine drugs triazolam, temazepam, and flunitrazepam and as such is indicated for the treatment of insomnia.

uses.text: Haloxazolam (marketed in Japan under the brand name Somelin), is a drug which is a benzodiazepine derivative. It has similar hypnotic properties as the benzodiazepine drugs triazolam, temazepam, and flunitrazepam and as such is indicated for the treatment of insomnia.

sideEffects.en: It can cause drowsiness, next day sleepiness, dizziness, poor coordination and memory problems. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能造成嗜睡、隔天昏沉、頭暈、協調變差和記憶問題。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，長期使用可能導致依賴，突然停藥可能引發危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能造成嗜睡、隔天昏沉、头晕、协调制差和记忆问题。和其他苯二氮平类一样，长期使用可能导致依赖，突然停药可能引发危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Haloxazolam is an oxazolobenzodiazepine: it carries an extra five-membered ring with oxygen and nitrogen fused onto the usual benzodiazepine core, like cloxazolam and ketazolam.
fact.zh: 鹵噁唑侖屬於噁唑并苯二氮平類：它在一般苯二氮平核心上多接了一個含氧與氮的五元環，和 cloxazolam、ketazolam 一樣。
fact.zhHans: 卤恶唑仑属于恶唑并苯二氮平类：它在一般苯二氮平内核上多接了一个含氧与氮的五元环，和 cloxazolam、ketazolam 一样。
